info.name: Id Repo (identity-service)
info.description:
Postman collection for IdRepoController (MOSIP id-repository, id-repository-identity-service).

Base path: /idrepository/v1/identity (port 8090).

Set `baseUrl` and `authToken` variables. All endpoints require `Authorization` cookie.

variable.description: Service base URL. For deployed envs: https://<env-domain> + same path.
JWT from authmanager (clientidsecretkey: clientId=mosip-idrepo-client, appId=idrepo). Sent as Authorization cookie.
Sample UIN (10-digit). Replace with a UIN existing in your environment.
Sample 16-digit VID. Replace with a VID existing in your environment.
UIN or VID of the individual.
Auto-filled by collection pre-request script. Do not set manually.

request.description: POST / — creates a new ID record (identity must match the configured ID schema). Role: postidrepo.
PATCH / — updates an existing ID record for a given UIN. Role: patchidrepo.
GET /idvid/{id} — deprecated; retrieves identity by UIN/VID. Role: getidvidid.
POST /idvid/ — retrieves identity; body is plain IdRequestByIdDTO. Role: postidvidid.

item.name: Retrieve Identity by Id V2 (POST, wrapped)

request.description: POST /idvid/v2 — same as /idvid/ but body wrapped in RequestWrapper. Role: postidvididv2.

item.name: Get Auth Type Status (by IdType, deprecated)

request.description: GET /authtypes/status/individualIdType/{IDType}/individualId/{ID} — deprecated since 1.2.0. IDType: UIN or VID.
POST /authtypes/status — locks/unlocks auth types for an individual. Role: postauthtypesstatus.
GET /rid/{individualId} — deprecated since 1.2.3; returns RID for a UIN/VID.
POST /idvid-metadata/search — returns IdVid metadata (incl. RID) for a UIN/VID. Role: postSearchIdVidMetadata.
GET /{individualId}/update-counts — remaining attribute-update counts. Role: remainingUpdateCountByIndividualId.
